title: Critical tribes coalitional influence bound
statement: For all sufficiently large natural numbers $w$, every coalition $J$ of coordinates of the critical tribes function whose size is at most $d/(800\log d)$ has coalitional influence at most $51/100$, where $d$ is the dimension of that function.
hypotheses_covered: a coalition $J$ in the critical tribes dimension
